sights.n: Ueno Farm, Asahikawa (上野ファーム)
sights.w: Gardener Ueno Sayuki's 'Hokkaido garden' — English planting blended with Furano-region wild nature; a mecca for Japanese gardeners on the Hokkaido Garden Path.

sights.n: Kaze no Garden, Furano (風のガーデン)
sights.address: New Furano Prince Hotel grounds, Furano, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: A 2,000 m² English garden of 20,000 flowers grown over two years as the set of Kuramoto Sō's TV drama 'Kaze no Garden'.

sights.n: Unkai Terrace, Hoshino Resorts Tomamu (雲海テラス)
sights.address: Tomamu, Shimukappu, Yūfutsu District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: A gondola-top deck at 1,088 m above the Tomamu valleys — on calm mornings from May to October a white sea of clouds fills the Hidaka foothills.

sights.n: Ikeda Wine Castle (池田ワイン城)
sights.w: The town-run winery in a European-style castle — underground cellars of oak barrels, a brandy still, Tokachi wines and a top-floor restaurant over the Tokachi Plain.
Hilltop gardens over Tokachi built on 'flowers, food and farming' — seven theme gardens including 800 rose bushes, herbs, fruit trees and edible flowers.
